svg.text: The ablutions and the coordinated transfer · LM-136A–LM-136E · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: Quod ore sumpsimus: the first ablution, of wine
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes chalice · L palm-on-corporal / R
AC1: standing · bow head-slight · predella-epistle · faces inward-to-priest · eyes chalice · L
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
wine-cruet @ In AC1's right hand at the Epistle side of the predella. [handle-toward-priest] —
UNRESOLVED: The approved material does not fix whether the priest moves toward the Epistle
corner of the predella for the ablutions; the corpus keeps him at the centre of the predella
with the chalice extended toward the Epistle side.
UNRESOLVED: The approved material does not fix whether AC1 brings both cruets up together or
returns the wine cruet before fetching the water, nor what his free hand does while he pours.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The second ablution, of water, with AC1 one step down
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes chalice · holding-chalice-both-hands
AC1: standing · bow head-slight · step-3-epistle · faces inward-to-priest · eyes chalice · L
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
chalice @ Held by the priest over the altar. [upright] — by priest
water-cruet @ In AC1's right hand, one altar step below the predella on the Epistle side.
UNRESOLVED: The approved material names only "Quod ore sumpsimus" among the ablution prayers and
does not fix any words said during the second, water ablution.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The first crossing, with AC2 in front
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-at-mensa-edge
AC1: walking · step-1-centre · faces gospel-side · eyes forward · holding-chalice-cloth
AC2: walking · step-1-centre · faces epistle-side · eyes forward · holding-missal
chalice-cloth @ In AC1's hands, carried to the Gospel side. [folded] — by AC1
UNRESOLVED: The approved material does not fix where AC1 obtains the chalice cloth before
carrying it to the Gospel side.
UNRESOLVED: The approved material fixes only that AC1 carries the chalice cloth to the Gospel
side and does not fix the level at which he stands when the priest takes it; the corpus places
him at step-3-gospel, one altar step below the predella, mirroring the anchor fixed for the
UNRESOLVED: The approved material does not fix what the priest does with the chalice and the
purificator between the second ablution and his receiving the chalice cloth.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The priest receives the chalice cloth
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces gospel-side · eyes forward · L
AC1: standing · bow head-slight · step-3-gospel · faces inward-to-priest · eyes inward-to-priest
AC2: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces inward-to-centre · eyes altar ·
chalice-cloth @ In the priest's hand at the altar, taken from AC1. [folded] — by priest
UNRESOLVED: The approved material does not fix where the priest stands when he takes the chalice
cloth, nor what he does with the cloth once he has it; the corpus keeps him at the centre of the
predella, turned toward the Gospel side to receive it.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The second crossing, with AC1 in front
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes altar · L on-altar-outside-corporal / R
AC1: walking · step-1-epistle · faces epistle-side · eyes forward · joined-before-breast
AC2: walking · step-1-gospel · faces gospel-side · eyes forward · joined-before-breast
chalice-cloth @ In the priest's hand at the altar. [folded] — by priest
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
